Xbox's Fable Game Main Story Length Reportedly Revealed

Reports indicate that the main story of the upcoming Xbox game Fable is estimated to take between 15 to 20 hours to complete. This duration is comparable to the length of another upcoming game, Avowed. The information regarding Fable's estimated playtime has been confirmed by Xbox.
